theorem shifted_absolute_convex_differentiable_iff (c : ℝ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : ℝ => |x - c|) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ => |w - c|) x ↔ x ≠ c

theorem hinge_convex_differentiable_iff {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (a : E) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : E => max (1 - inner ℝ a x) 0) ∧
      ∀ x : E, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : E => max (1 - inner ℝ a w) 0) x ↔
        inner ℝ a x ≠ 1

target_verdicts.exact_header:
theorem labelled_hinge_convex_differentiable_iff {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (y : ℝ) (z : E) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : E => max (1 - y * inner ℝ z x) 0) ∧
      (∀ x : E, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : E => max (1 - y * inner ℝ z w) 0) x ↔
        y * inner ℝ z x ≠ 1) ∧
      (Differentiable ℝ (fun w : E => max (1 - y * inner ℝ z w) 0) ↔ y • z = 0)

theorem history_succ (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (t : ℕ) :
    history V η loss x₁ p (t + 1) =
      Fin.snoc (history V η loss x₁ p t)
        (BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.project V
          (output V η loss x₁ p t - η t • selected V η loss x₁ p t))

BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientPolicy.one_ste.statement:
theorem one_step_chain (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (t : ℕ) (hη : 0 < η t)
    (hloss : BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.SubdifferentiableOn V (loss t))
    (hg : selected V η loss x₁ p t ∈ SourceSubdifferential (loss t) (output V η loss x₁ p t))
    (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) :
    η t * ((loss t (output V η loss x₁ p t)).toReal - (loss t u).toReal) ≤
      η t * inner ℝ (selected V η loss x₁ p t) (output V η loss x₁ p t - u) ∧
    η t * inner ℝ (selected V η loss x₁ p t) (output V η loss x₁ p t - u) ≤
      ‖output V η loss x₁ p t - u‖ ^ 2 / 2 -
      ‖output V η loss x₁ p (t + 1) - u‖ ^ 2 / 2 +
      (η t) ^ 2 / 2 * ‖selected V η loss x₁ p t‖ ^ 2

BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientPolicy.one_ste.statement:
theorem one_step (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (t : ℕ) (hη : 0 < η t)
    (hloss : BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.SubdifferentiableOn V (loss t))
    (hg : selected V η loss x₁ p t ∈ SourceSubdifferential (loss t) (output V η loss x₁ p t))
    (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) :
    (loss t (output V η loss x₁ p t)).toReal - (loss t u).toReal ≤
      (‖output V η loss x₁ p t - u‖ ^ 2 -
        ‖output V η loss x₁ p (t + 1) - u‖ ^ 2) / (2 * η t) +
      η t / 2 * ‖selected V η loss x₁ p t‖ ^ 2

BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientPolicy.regret_.statement:
theorem regret_fixed (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E))
    (hx₁ : x₁ ∈ V.carrier) (T : ℕ)
    (hloss : ∀ t < T, BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.SubdifferentiableOn V (loss t))
    (hlegal : LegalFeedback V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p T) (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) :
    regret V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p u T ≤ ‖x₁ - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) +
      η / 2 * (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖selected V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p t‖ ^ 2) -
      ‖output V (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p T - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η)

    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (hx₁ : x₁ ∈ V.carrier) (T : ℕ)

theorem unit_exponents {D : Type*} [AddCommGroup D] (X L H : D) (h : H + (L - X) = X) :
    H = X + X - L

seven_slots.objects: Abstract additive commutative group D; no geometric E.
seven_slots.quantifiers: All X,L,H satisfying update-dimension equation.
seven_slots.assumptions: H+(L-X)=X only.
seven_slots.conclusion: H=X+X-L.
seven_slots.source_delta: Conditional exponent algebra, not a physical unit checker.

target_verdicts.header:
theorem regret_unit_exponents {D : Type*} [AddCommGroup D] (X L : D) :
    (X + X - (X + X - L) = L) ∧ ((X + X - L) + (L - X) + (L - X) = L)

seven_slots.objects: Abstract additive group D.
seven_slots.quantifiers: All X,L.
seven_slots.assumptions: No consistency premise needed after substitution.
seven_slots.conclusion: Both coarse terms have exponent L.
seven_slots.normalization: Two squared-gradient exponents and step exponent.
seven_slots.source_delta: Coherence only, not regret performance.

    scaledLoss c⁻¹ (scaledLoss c f) = f

seven_slots.objects: Whole functions E to EReal.
seven_slots.quantifiers: Every f and positive c.
seven_slots.assumptions: c>0; no properness.
seven_slots.conclusion: Inverse pullback restores f pointwise.
seven_slots.source_delta: Total extended-real identity, not finiteness.

seven_slots.assumptions: SourceProper: no bottom and a finite witness.
seven_slots.conclusion: Scaled loss proper.
seven_slots.source_delta: Properness does not imply everywhere finite.

seven_slots.objects: Global EReal supports.
seven_slots.quantifiers: Every y,g with support at c*y.
seven_slots.assumptions: c>0, proper f, actual global support.
seven_slots.conclusion: c*g supports transformed loss at y for ALL ambient points.
seven_slots.source_delta: One-way membership; not a set equality.
